summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI Batch A iteration 195: Bot Actions Panel and Predictive Zero-Click Navigation. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). All 12 frontend UI tests passed (100%). Both new Batch A features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: enzi_bots.py: BOT_ACTIONS dict defines actions for each bot (poll: start_poll, standup: run_standup, reminder: set_reminder, meeting: start_meeting, welcome: send_welcome, summary: run_summary, translator: translate, github_notify: check_status). Handler functions generate formatted messages.
enzi_bots.py: GET /lumi/bots/channel/{id} returns installed bots with their available actions. POST /lumi/bots/action validates bot is installed before executing, returns 404 if not installed.
lumi_predict.py: POST /lumi/predict/track stores user actions with hour/day_of_week for time-based predictions. Updates frequency counters in lumi_action_freq collection.
lumi_predict.py: GET /lumi/predict/suggestions uses frequency + time-based scoring. Actions matching current hour get +2 boost. Returns top 5 channels and DMs.
BotActionsBar.jsx: Shows '3 bots active' toggle below chat header. Expands to show action buttons with icons. Executes actions via POST /api/lumi/bots/action, shows toast on success.
LumiMessenger.jsx: predictedChannelIds/predictedDmIds Sets drive Zap icon display. sortedChannels/sortedDms sort predicted items first, then by unread count. trackAction() called on channel/dm visit.
seed_data_creation: Bot actions created poll, standup, and reminder messages during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch A features verified working: 1) Bot Actions Panel - GET /api/lumi/bots/channel/{id} returns installed bots with actions array. POST /api/lumi/bots/action executes action and posts message. BotActionsBar shows '3 bots active' toggle, expands to show action buttons (Set Reminder, Start Poll, Run Standup). 2) Predictive Navigation - POST /api/lumi/predict/track records user actions with time context. GET /api/lumi/predict/suggestions returns scored predictions. Frontend sortedChannels/sortedDms put predicted items first. Zap (⚡) icons appear next to predicted channels in sidebar. 3) Previous features still work: Bot Store, Meeting History, Meeting Modal all accessible from dashboard.
